title: Signal at dawn
panels: At the edge of the town, Ari found a small light on an old post. It blinked once toward the hills.
Ari drew the light in a notebook and left a simple mark for the next traveller.
With the town still asleep, Ari followed the morning path toward the ridge.

title: Across the ridge
panels: Above the town, the path divided. Another traveller was studying the same small mark.
They compared their notes. One had a map of the paths; the other had marked the places with water.
Together they chose the gentler route, leaving a clear sign at the turning.

title: The shared light
panels: The path reached a clearing where people had gathered around another light.
Each traveller added something useful: a map, a question, a story or a place to sit.
By evening the signal had become a meeting place. Ari opened a fresh page in the notebook.
